title: 第13章 头上有点绿第14章 中邪
slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬
content_zh:
第13章头上有点绿
助理是最先看到亲戚发过来的调查资料的，匆匆看了一眼，表情顿时那个一言难尽啊。
助理默默道：嘶，季哥头上有点绿啊。
事关重大，助理不敢耽搁，趁着吃晚饭的时间赶紧把季锋休息室的门锁好，然后把资料发给了季锋。
季锋从助理那凝重的表情就知道恐怕出了问题，可当他真看到资料里的照片时，还是没忍住一阵愤怒。
照片中，他的女朋友坐在驾驶座，正歪头和副驾驶一个二十出头的年轻男孩接着吻！
……
下午五点，林熙终于把买的所有生活用品和家电器具等东西搬到了店里。
因为她买的多，商场便包揽了送货业务，只是知道她住在丧葬一条街之后，师傅们纷纷表示只能帮她送到街口。
林熙也不强求，表示没问题。
等到师傅们将货卸在街口之后，便趁附近没人的时候又使了御鬼术召了几个小鬼帮忙。
小鬼们不怕累，没一会就把东西搬完了。
林熙一直在街口守着，本想和街口那家店的店主，也是她唯一的活人邻居打声招呼认识一下，可惜店主早早就关门回家，这下整条街又只有林熙一个人了。
东西搬回去之后也不用她动手整理，小鬼们很上道的帮着料理后续事宜。
五点十分，丁鹏的电话打了过来。
“小林大师，咱们现在走吗？”
林熙：“好，你到街口等我，我马上来。”
这街口是哪里不用林熙说丁鹏也知道了，如果说昨晚知道林熙住在丧葬一条街，丁鹏会说这姑娘是在找死。
但现在，他只能感慨艺高人胆大。
一分钟后，林熙来到街口，丁鹏已经在那等着了，和他一起的还有三个身强体壮的男人，是丁鹏提前叫上的亲戚。

上午他回到家把这事跟妻子说了之后，妻子第一反应就是不相信，这也太玄乎了吧，世界上真的有这么厉害的算命大师吗？虽然林熙的那张符确实有效，可是她真的连这些东西都能算出来吗？
但她又忍不住想，万一下午真的会出事呢，那大儿子可怎么办？
他们不敢赌，赌不起。
所以最终还是叫上了自己娘家几个堂哥表哥，下午跟丁鹏一块去学校接孩子。
林熙见到几张陌生面孔也没说什么，只让丁鹏带路。
丁鹏也不耽搁时间，很快就带着几人朝小学门口走去。
一直到小学门口的时候，一年级的学生已经在校门内由老师带着排队了。
丁鹏心里有事，一来到校门口便开始四处张望，表情也严肃谨慎，生怕别人不知道他在盯着谁似的。
林熙：“……”
她无奈开口：“你先正常一点。”
就算是有人想做什么，被丁鹏这表情一扫，怕是都不敢动手了。
丁鹏一听，结结巴巴解释道。
“我就是紧张，紧张的。”
不过听了林熙的话他也意识到，这会还不能暴露目的。

Chapter 13 A little green on the head
The assistant was the first to see the survey information sent by his relatives. He took a quick glance at it and his expression suddenly became indescribable.
The assistant said silently: Hey, Brother Ji's head is a little green.
The matter was so important that the assistant did not dare to delay. He quickly locked the door of Ji Feng's lounge during dinner time and then sent the information to Ji Feng.
Ji Feng knew from the assistant's solemn expression that something was wrong, but when he actually saw the photo in the file, he still couldn't hold back a burst of anger.
In the photo, his girlfriend is sitting in the driver's seat, tilting her head and kissing the co-pilot, a young boy in his early twenties!
…
At five o'clock in the afternoon, Lin Xi finally moved all the daily necessities, household appliances and other things she bought into the store.
Because she bought a lot, the mall took over the delivery business. But after learning that she lived on the funeral street, the chefs said they could only help her deliver to the corner of the street.
Lin Xi didn't force it and said it was no problem.
After the masters unloaded the goods at the street entrance, they used ghost control skills to summon a few ghosts to help when no one was nearby.
The little guys were not afraid of getting tired and finished moving their things in a short time.
Lin Xi had been guarding the street. She originally wanted to say hello to the owner of the shop at the street entrance, who was also her only living neighbor. Unfortunately, the shop owner closed the shop early and went home. Now Lin Xi was the only one on the street.
After moving the things back, she didn't have to tidy them up. The little devils were very helpful in handling the follow-up matters.
At ten minutes past five, Ding Peng called.
"Master Xiaolin, shall we leave now?"
Lin Xi: "Okay, wait for me at the street corner, I'll be right back."
Ding Peng didn't need to tell Lin Xi about where this street was. If he had known that Lin Xi lived on the funeral street last night, Ding Peng would have said that this girl was looking for death.
But now, he can only lament the boldness of talented people.
A minute later, Lin Xi came to the street corner, where Ding Peng was already waiting. With him were three strong men, relatives whom Ding Peng had called in advance.
When he got home in the morning and told his wife about this, her first reaction was that she didn't believe it. This was too mysterious. Is there really such a powerful fortune teller in the world? Although Lin Xi's talisman is indeed effective, can she really calculate these things?
But she couldn't help but think, what if something really happened in the afternoon, what would her eldest son do?
They dare not gamble and cannot afford to gamble.
So in the end, I called some of my cousins ​​from my natal family, and went with Ding Peng to pick up the children from school in the afternoon.
Lin Xi didn't say anything when she saw a few unfamiliar faces and just let Ding Peng lead the way.
Ding Peng didn't waste any time and quickly led a few people towards the entrance of the primary school.
By the time they arrived at the gate of the primary school, the first-grade students were already queuing up inside the school gate led by their teachers.
Ding Peng had something on his mind. As soon as he arrived at the school gate, he started to look around with a serious and cautious expression, as if he was afraid that others would not know who he was staring at.
Lin Xi: "..."
She said helplessly: "Just be normal first."
Even if someone wanted to do something, Ding Peng's expression would make them afraid to do anything.
When Ding Peng heard this, he stammered and explained.
"I'm just nervous, nervous."
However, after listening to Lin Xi's words, he also realized that the purpose of this meeting could not be revealed.
